author: Ubisoft
description:
Season 20 is live now in Riders Republic! This season is packed full of awesome content. Two iconic Scooter brands join the adventure, Ethic and Envy, alongside our Full Send model. But that’s not all! Riders Republic is celebrating its 5th anniversary this year. Get ready to unlock lots of exclusive rewards throughout the season. More information on www.ridersrepublic.com 

About Riders Republic:
Jump into a massive extreme sports multiplayer open-world across America’s National Parks. From bike races to snow parks and more, your journey starts now! Immerse yourself in iconic American national parks including Bryce Canyon, Yosemite Valley, Mammoth Mountain. Play solo or squad up with your friends and compete in a wide range of events, or give it your best shot in epic mass PvP races with 50+ other players.

#Ubisoft #RidersRepublic
